title: HGB sizer: the 037 label:buy HGB as the capital-neutral stake sizer on the width book (cs_aro's design), backtested on all 15 folds
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26), and the late half is NOT blind (see seen_before). A pass is PASS (PROVISIONAL) with a forward-confirmation route. Nothing is adopted or promoted.
arm_class: NNNC_CS_HGB = NNNC_CS_ARO with WidthSizerMixin.sizer_score taken from the fold's HGB p_buy (user_data/data/hgb_sizer/HGB_fNN.parquet, research/hgb_sizer/signals.py); entries, ARO weights (model keys equal cs_aro's), AGREE_SHARE 0.5, STAKE_WEIGHTS (1.0, 0.5) -> 1.333x / 0.667x, HELD_PAIR_ADD off: all cs_aro's. A width-book entry with no HGB row scores 0 (disagree).
hgb: 037 label:buy model (research/indicator_screen preregistration models.hgb settings, unchanged): gbb candidate bars with meta:data_ok, every 037 scored column without btc: (incl. the post-lock extras: raw8, ni:, price/close), fitted per fold on rows from train_start to 48 bars BEFORE the pair's validation tail (the strategy's own TRAIN_DATA_SPLIT 0.8 split of [train_start, test_start)); scored on candidate bars from the tail start to the fold's test end
thresholds: per fold, research/hgb_sizer/pick.py: cs_aro's rule on the HGB score -- first bar of each width-book run in the fold's validation tail, (1 - 0.5) quantile, 4 decimals; tail_leak_pairs must be empty; verify every fold (tag mismatches 0, loaded == stored)

instrument.per_half: trade set == w_aro on (pair, open_date, close_date) in all but <= 2 folds; 0 entry violations; 0 tag mismatches; thresholds loaded at 4 dp; mean capital ratio vs w_aro within +-10%; no zero-trade fold; width-book entries without an HGB p_buy <= 1%

pass: judge_one(cs_hgb, w_aro) PASS AND judge_one(cs_hgb, wf_aro_g24) PASS -- cs_aro's own bar
secondary: judge_one(cs_hgb, cs_aro) on the same trades: PASS = the HGB sizer beats the ARO sizer (reported; replacing ARO as the sizer needs this AND the primary PASS)
small_margin_rule: if any primary half gain is < 1 pp, a PASS is INCONCLUSIVE (the HGB is deterministic, random_state 0; the repeat would be the forward window, not a seed)
confirmation_route: post-2026-09-07 folds (plan_fwd_*) or dry-run; NOTE live use would need the 794 037 columns (643 values + 151 raw signals) computed at runtime -- not assessed here
seen_before: 037 (screen, all halves incl. late): label:buy candidate-bar AUC, HGB all columns 0.619 early / 0.625 late vs ARO p_buy 0.607 / 0.597 vs width sort 0.549 / 0.554 (HGB there was fitted up to the fold start; here it stops before the validation tail)
cs_aro backtest on all 15 folds: 59.95 pp vs w_aro 51.44 vs wf_aro_g24 49.97 (control_sizer report); its forward window was INCONSISTENT
backtest P&L of w_aro, wf_aro_g24 and cs_aro on all 15 folds (comparators)
no backtest or simulator split of the width-book trades by HGB p_buy has been run
question: does the 037 HGB's better within-candidate ranking (AUC, both halves) survive real execution as a width-book sizer, above the width book, the control and the ARO sizer?
